The General 
Council of the Bar

Has been called to the Bar of England and Wales by the Honourable Society of Gray's Inn, 
having satisfied all requirements for admission including completion of the Bar Practice 
Course, pupillage, and demonstration of professional competence and character. Mr. 
Blackstone is hereby authorized to practice as a barrister in England and Wales.
